subject: Unforeseen fire protection field condition: standpipe riser location conflicting with the

messages.text: Sprinkler crew found the standpipe riser location conflicting with the structural bracing at Room 214; it's similar to the condition noted in last month's inspection log, but this one isn't shown on Fire Protection Sheet FP-101. This needs a quick turnaround; work is stopped pending direction. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This could affect the overall schedule. A response within three business days would be appreciated.
Reroute to clear the conflict at Room 214 per the attached sketch; proceed once clearance is confirmed. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum.

The extent of the standpipe riser location conflicting with the structural bracing at Room 214 is more than we first reported -- does your direction still cover it? A response within three business days would be appreciated.
